items.exampleEn: The bookshop sorts its novels by genre, such as mystery and romance.
items.exampleZh: 那家書店把小說依種類擺放，例如推理和愛情。

items.exampleEn: The palace employs ten gardeners to look after its roses.
items.exampleZh: 那座宮殿聘了十位園丁照顧玫瑰。

items.exampleEn: Before each rehearsal, the conductor spends hours studying the music alone at home.
items.exampleZh: 每次排練前，那位指揮都會獨自在家花好幾個小時研讀樂譜。

items.exampleEn: Long ago, hunting was the main way to get food in this area.
items.exampleZh: 很久以前，打獵是這個地區取得食物的主要方式。

items.exampleEn: According to legend, a giant fish once lived in this lake.
items.exampleZh: 傳說這座湖裡曾經住著一條巨大的魚。

items.exampleEn: The designer drew a simple heart icon for the new website.
items.exampleZh: 設計師為新網站畫了一個簡單的愛心圖示。

items.exampleEn: In this book, the narrator never tells us her real name.
items.exampleZh: 這本書的敘述者始終沒告訴我們她的真名。

items.exampleEn: The restaurant's legendary beef soup has drawn long lines for forty years.
items.exampleZh: 那家餐廳傳奇的牛肉湯四十年來一直大排長龍。

items.exampleEn: The lyrics were printed inside the album cover.
items.exampleZh: 歌詞印在專輯封套的內頁。

items.sentenceEn: I love this song, but I can never remember the lyrics.
items.sentenceZh: 我很喜歡這首歌，但總是記不住歌詞。

items.audioEn: The conductor will check your tickets after the train leaves the station.
items.audioZh: 火車離站後，列車長會來查票。
options: At the end of the trip

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather is a keen gardener who grows his own vegetables.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺是個熱愛園藝的人，自己種菜。

items.sentenceEn: We spent the whole weekend house hunting in the suburbs.
items.sentenceZh: 我們整個週末都在郊區看房子。

items.stemEn: Which ____ of music do you enjoy most: jazz, rock or pop?
items.stemZh: 你最喜歡哪一種類型的音樂：爵士、搖滾還是流行？

items.stemEn: The ____ is the voice that tells the story in a novel.
items.stemZh: 敘述者是小說裡講故事的那個聲音。

items.passageEn: Our town's summer arts festival has something for every taste. On Friday, a famous conductor led the city orchestra in a free concert in the park. On Saturday, children went treasure hunting around the old castle, following clues based on a local legend about a lost crown. A retired gardener gave a talk on growing roses, and a group of young writers read short stories from many different genres. The highlight was a concert by a legendary rock singer, a true music icon. Thousands of fans sang every word of the lyrics, and the narrator of the festival film said it was the best night in years.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上的夏季藝術節，各種喜好的人都能找到樂趣。星期五，一位知名指揮帶領市立樂團在公園舉辦免費音樂會。星期六，孩子們在古堡周圍尋寶，線索來自一則關於失落王冠的當地傳說。一位退休園丁分享了種玫瑰的心得，一群年輕作家朗讀了各種風格的短篇小說。重頭戲是一位傳奇搖滾歌手的演唱會，他是真正的音樂代表人物。數千名歌迷跟著唱出每一句歌詞，藝術節紀錄片的旁白說，那是多年來最棒的一晚。

questions.questionZh: 孩子們尋寶的線索來自什麼？
options: 一位園丁畫的花園地圖
一則關於失落王冠的傳說

questions.questionZh: 藝術節的重頭戲是什麼？
options: 傳奇搖滾歌手的演唱會
退休園丁分享種玫瑰的講座

items.promptZh: 這位歌手是她那個時代的傳奇人物。
referenceEn: This singer was a legend in her time.
The singer is a legend of her generation.
rubricZh: legend 指「傳奇人物」（例如 a legend in her time）
時態合理即可（例如 was、is）

items.instructionZh: 用 icon 造一個句子，說說你手機或電腦上常用的一個圖示。
referenceEn: I tap the camera icon on my phone many times a day.
The weather icon on my home screen shows a little sun today.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 icon（例如 the camera icon）
句子要說到你自己的手機或電腦
